name: Sandbag Loading to Platform
description: A strongman event where multiple sandbags of increasing weight are loaded onto a platform or series of boxes. The athlete must move quickly and efficiently through multiple bags under fatigue. Speed, technique, and endurance are all tested in this event.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Sandbag Loading to Platform in proper strongman position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare all equipment and body position for Sandbag Loading to Platform.
steps: Step 1: Position first sandbag in front of target platform.
Step 2: Bear hug or deadlift bag to lap then continue up to platform height.
Step 3: Load bag onto platform and immediately move to next bag.
Step 4: Continue loading all bags as quickly as possible.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace core maximally before every lift. Breathe between reps if needed.
common_mistakes: Using poor technique as fatigue accumulates
safety_considerations: Use collars on all loaded barbells.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion specific to the implement being used.
coaching_cues: Speed is the goal, maintain form throughout
Have next bag positioned before finishing last
